$comment: spaarkeai-compose-r2 DEF-08 (Part A) — compose-draft-document Action SEED (systemPrompt home). ACTION-ONLY, no playbook: per ADR-039 a capability is an Action row + Binding row, and the Compose R2 engine is frozen (NO new sprk_analysisplaybook records). This file is the mirror-first author surface for the sprk_analysisaction row (sprk_actioncode=compose-draft-document) carrying the JPS systemPrompt + Azure-OpenAI-Structured-Outputs output schema. Deploy via scripts/Deploy-AnalysisAction.ps1 (action-only; upsert by sprk_actioncode). The Binding that routes to it is in sprk_playbookconsumer-rows.json and DECLARES the core `compose` disposition (BindingDisposition.Compose = 100000006). The input/output schema mirrors under infra/dataverse/inputschemas|outputschemas are the CI-validated projections of this row. Owner hygiene: actionCode carries NO version suffix (compose-draft-document, not @v1).
$comment-vs-draft-correspondence: §11 Component Justification — this is a NEW Action, NOT a reuse of DRAFT-CORR@v1. draft-correspondence's output schema is EMAIL-shaped ({subject, recipients_suggestion, plain-text body capped 6000, forced salutation + '[Your name]' closing}) with the Informational disposition rendering inline Assistant prose. It cannot represent an editor-seedable FULL DOCUMENT body (memo, response, agreement, general document) as drafting-ready HTML, and reusing it would force every 'write a memo/document' into letter shape. This Action emits a full-document body_html + title with the `compose` disposition so SendWorkspaceArtifactHandler can seed a Compose tab from the ledger output.
$comment-disposition: UNLIKE draft-correspondence (Informational, inline prose), this Action's Binding declares the core `compose` disposition (sprk_disposition = 100000006). The LLM emits a FULL-DOCUMENT payload ({title, body_html, document_kind, cited_refs}) written to the session ledger as a SessionOutput under the `compose` disposition BEFORE any render (ADR-040 storage-precedes-rendering). SendWorkspaceArtifactHandler resolves the recent full-document compose output (detected by the body_html field) and seeds the opened Compose tab with a ledgerRef; the client materializes the document from the ledger. The disposition lives on the Binding row (sprk_disposition), not here.
$comment-body-html-contract: body_html is the LOAD-BEARING discriminator: SendWorkspaceArtifactHandler distinguishes a full-document compose output from a compose-draft-alternative EDIT payload (target_text/new_text) by the presence of a non-empty body_html string. Keep body_html as the full-document body field; do not rename it without updating SendWorkspaceArtifactHandler.ResolveComposeDraftSeed.
name: Compose — Draft Document
description: Draft a complete, editor-ready document (a letter, memo, response, notice, or other document) grounded in the session's documents and ledger outputs, for opening in the Compose editor (DEF-08). Unlike draft-correspondence (which drafts a client email/letter to SEND via the Communication service and renders inline prose), this capability produces a full drafting-ready document body as semantic HTML with a title, written to the session ledger under the `compose` disposition so it opens in a Compose editor tab the attorney can revise and Save. Use when the user asks to draft/write/compose a document to work on in the editor.
$comment-actionType: ExecutorType.AiAnalysis = 0 — handled by the existing prompt-driven executor (ActionRunner + PromptSchemaRenderer). No new executor (ADR-039 reuse).
$comment-temperature: Moderate temperature — drafting a full document needs faithful substance grounded in the session material with enough latitude to produce coherent, well-organized prose. Higher than the read/explain actions (0.2) because it composes new document text, but grounded in the supplied documents.
systemPrompt:
ROLE: You are the Spaarke Compose document drafter. The user has asked you to draft or write a document (a letter, memo, response, notice, agreement, or other document) about the material in this conversation. You produce a COMPLETE, drafting-ready document that will open in the Compose editor for the user to revise and save — not inline chat prose. INPUT: the session's documents and any prior ledger outputs (summaries, comparisons) the retrieval layer supplied, plus the user's drafting request. INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Draft a complete, self-contained document responsive to the user's request, grounded in the session material. Organize it appropriately for the document kind (e.g. a letter has a salutation, body paragraphs, and a closing; a memo has a heading block and sections). 2. Emit a JSON object matching the output schema EXACTLY. additionalProperties is false; do not add fields. 3. title: a short, specific title for the document (≤200 chars) — used as the Compose tab title and document name (e.g. 'Client Letter — Acme NDA Findings'). 4. body_html: the FULL document body as SEMANTIC HTML the editor renders directly.
